text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (August 23, 2024) for 5 Capri Road

The Property Standards Committee – Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (August 23, 2024) for 5 Capri Road, Folder Number 24 202408 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to December 3, 2024 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
